story_ticket: Close-up of the top edge of a modern smartphone in a dark cozy bedroom at night. The black pill-shaped cutout at the top of the screen glows with a thin soft violet light along a tiny crack, and a small lavender paper ticket with torn perforated edges and a few curly made-up glyphs is drifting down out of it, surrounded by tiny floating sparkles. Warm bokeh of string lights in the background. No brand logo on the phone.
story_recipe: An old handwritten recipe card lying on a wooden kitchen counter under a warm hanging lamp: slightly yellowed paper with soft creases, lines of curly made-up alien glyphs in faded violet ink (not any real alphabet), small doodles of a rice ball and a steaming bowl, and at the bottom corner a tiny stamped mark shaped like a little chef hat. A glass jar of glowing lavender salt and a sprig of herbs beside it.
story_envelope: A rain-dampened lavender envelope tucked under the edge of a striped pastel shop awning on a rainy evening, raindrops beading on it, sealed with a tiny round wax seal pressed with a little chef-hat shape, a line of curly made-up glyph handwriting on the front. Puddles reflecting warm shop-window light.
story_planet: A round storybook map of a tiny cozy planet seen from above, like an illustrated globe map on old paper, divided into many small soft regions: a bay, rice hills, a soup-pot village, a honey valley, carrot fields, a lily lake, a misty tea mountain, a moon ferry dock, a star market, a lighthouse cape, little stone houses, a fountain, a snowy ridge, and one tiny round shop in the exact center. Almost everything is dim dusky blue-gray and sleepy, only two or three regions glow with warm golden light.
story_shop_dark: A tiny round cozy shop on a small alien planet at night under a starry sky: round windows, a chimney, a crooked hand-painted wooden sign with one curly glyph symbol, lavender walls. Everything is dark and quiet, the street is dim blue, only one small warm light glows in one window. On the doorstep sit an empty ceramic bowl and a tiny white chef hat.
story_shop_lit: A tiny round cozy shop on a small alien planet at night under a starry sky: round windows, a chimney puffing warm steam, a crooked hand-painted wooden sign with one curly glyph symbol, lavender walls. Everything is glowing: every window bright and golden, paper lanterns lit along the path, string lights, floating sparkles, warm festive light spilling onto the street.
story_maps: Two torn halves of an old hand-drawn map joined together on a wooden table on a rooftop at night, lit by starlight through a glass skylight and a small lantern: a dotted line travels from a glowing star in the corner, through a round glowing door in the middle, down to a tiny street at the bottom where one small window is lit and marked with a little heart-shaped pin. Telescope and a cozy blanket softly out of focus.
story_door: A huge round stone door in a dim round stone room, carved with spiral star patterns, opening just a crack: warm golden light pours through the narrow gap and spreads across a star-patterned carpet runner leading to it. Floating soft light orbs, glowing crystal clusters and lavender-flowered vines on the walls. Magical, hopeful mood.
story_branch: A polaroid photo lying on a snowy wooden windowsill at night, warm light from inside: the photo shows a small shop window with a crooked cardboard sign propped in it, hand-drawn with crayon as two big wobbly curly squiggle symbols (no letters). A small sprig of pine and a ribbon next to the photo.
story_hat: A small kraft-paper parcel just opened on a soft rug near a warm fireplace, tied with lavender ribbon and star-patterned tape, and inside on white tissue paper a tiny pet-sized white chef hat made of soft cotton, slightly worn, with a little embroidered star. Snowflakes visible through a frosted window in the background.
story_egg: A polaroid photo pinned on a cozy wall near a fireplace with snow outside the window: the photo shows a single egg with a pale peach shell and mint-green swirl pattern (definitely not purple), sitting on a soft knitted blanket, with one thin glowing crack across it. Warm, hopeful, a little mysterious.
